data.narrative:
Pryzm is a Seed-stage defense and security technology company that has raised $14.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression approach uses the $14.2M total raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, implying a valuation of $36M. The Peer-Median method references three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A). The median across these peers is $400M, with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

The two methods produce meaningfully different signals. Synthesizing across both approaches yields a triangulated valuation range of $30M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $218M. The wide spread reflects the significant heterogeneity in recent Defense & Security valuations at early stages. Key uncertainties include whether Pryzm's technology differentiation and market traction align with the upper-quartile peers in the comp set, and the degree to which macro funding conditions for frontier defense tech have stabilized post-2023.
